policy: Only configurations listed here may be described as real-Live-qualified.

scope: scene launch (no bespoke undo; recommends transport stop)
send/return-track control (return-track enumeration, get/set send level)
supervised MIDI clip creation (exact empty slot only)
sample import to an exact empty clip slot
device insertion (append-only, allowlisted): EQ Eight, Glue Compressor, Saturator, Auto Filter, Drum Buss, Compressor, Hybrid Reverb, Echo
device removal (identity-bound undo of an insertion)

existing-device parameter control (name-agnostic; qualified reversible parameters include EQ Eight Output/Gain/Q/Frequency, Compressor Threshold/Ratio/Output, Utility Stereo Width, Glue Compressor Threshold/Dry-Wet, Saturator Drive/Dry-Wet, Auto Filter Resonance/Dry-Wet, Drum Buss Drive/Dry-Wet)

interruption/recovery: offline read during inspection, Live closing after a proposal but before confirmation, a companion restart with a pending proposal, and stale-undo refusal all verified to fail cleanly with no false success
